svg.title: Bricklayer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as bricklayer, wearing an apron and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed masonry trowel with an angled raised handle is paired with two staggered brick courses. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
